task: Explore: new research-algorithm tool ventures/scale-reliability (Cronbach's alpha, McDonald's omega, Guttman's lambdas, item analysis)
errors: factor_analyzer 0.5.1 fails with scikit-learn >= 1.6 (check_array force_all_finite); pinned scikit-learn 1.5.2 in a scratch venv for the reference script only.
First draft of the stdlib SAS XPORT reader mis-handled missing values; fixed and cross-checked against pandas read_sas (identical 1,500 rows).
The coverage simulation at n = 1000 took ~25 minutes (jackknife of n one-factor fits per data set); ran in the background.

doc_friction.issue: No pointer to which research-algorithm topics are already covered; I had to grep 1,391 venture READMEs by keyword. portfolio/research-tools/README.md's table is the real index and could be named in the explore prompt.

notes: Explore idea: scale reliability as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/scale-reliability); no venture computed Cronbach's alpha or omega. Engine: alpha + Feldt CI, standardised alpha, Guttman lambda-2/6, one-factor minres omega (raw and standardised), BCa bootstrap for alpha and omega with jackknife acceleration, item analysis, reverse-key detection, Spearman-Brown, SEM. Verified on NHANES 2017-2018 PHQ-9 (1,500 respondents, public domain): pingouin 0.7.0 alpha to 1e-12, Feldt CI vs scipy to 1e-9, factor_analyzer minres loadings to 1e-5, scipy BFGS ULS omega to 1e-7, numpy lambdas to 1e-10. Coverage simulation (300 x 6 settings): with unequal loadings Feldt alpha CI covers true reliability 93% / 73% / 11% at n = 50 / 200 / 1000; omega BCa 93-95%. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README, research-tools row and post carry everything the next run needs.
